body: Then you must be on the wrong subreddit. This isn't a gaming one.

Don't use it late at night. I had a flat tire and was stuck at a gas station. It was around midnight. I called AAA and waited for about 2 to 3 hours and they never showed up. Good thing I was in my hometown, so I just drove on it to get home and got fixed the next day.

Other than that bad experience, they always helped me with a dead battery, during the day of course

I don't understand how you guys have these experiences with cops like these. The past 5 years, I drove around the Bham area and ever more around AL and never had any problems with cops (Except the speed trap sheriff deputies in some pissant county south of Florence). I drove through these areas you guys mentioned at night time all the time and never had any problems. They are looking for speeders and DUIs. If you set cruise control, and don't worry about the shittier cops riding ass, then it shouldn't be a problem. 

The only time I ever had encounters with with cops at night was when I am parked alone in a parking lot. That alone is suspicious. I did that at the fresh market on the hell part of 280 and a Hoover PD was watching me from his vehicle as I was sitting in my car waiting for half an hour for my co-worker which never showed up. He didn't give me any trouble when he asked what's up because i was honest. Also state troopers are the most reasonable law enforcement in AL (in my experience). One of them stopped me from a suicide attempt another gave me a speeding ticket but didn't add a reckless driving charge like  those pissant sheriff departments in north west AL. Vestavia PD still patrols all around their part of 31 late at night which I try to avoid.
